_readme: Two settings the crew depends on: (1) bots answer other bots only when mentioned, with OpenClaw's built-in loop protection as a safety net; (2) sessions reset once a day at a fixed local hour, but a thread only resets after 24 hours without activity. Field names follow the OpenClaw documentation for Discord (`allowBots`, `botLoopProtection`) and sessions (`session.reset`, `resetByType`); check them against your OpenClaw version before applying. Delete the underscore fields before merging into your real config.
_notes: allowBots: "mentions" means a bot-authored message starts a turn only if it actively mentions this bot (a plain name does nothing). The documented values are true, false and "mentions".
botLoopProtection limits how many bot-to-bot events one pair may produce per time window, then stays quiet for a cooldown. The numbers below are examples, not recommendations.

atHour is local time of the gateway machine. scripts/automation/reset-notice.mjs sends its before/after notices around a reset hour written in the script (constants PRE_FROM, RESET_AT, POST_UNTIL); keep the two in step.

resetByType accepts direct, group and thread. With these values the main area of a channel resets daily at atHour, and each task thread resets only after idleMinutes (1440 = 24 hours) without activity.
